caregiver_concerns.content: Charyn expressed broad concerns regarding Sabrina's overall development. She highlighted significant issues in Sabrina's ability to maintain attention during activities, noting Sabrina often becomes distracted and struggles to focus during simple play tasks. Charyn is also worried about Sabrina's fine motor skill development, mentioning difficulty in manipulating small objects and completing age-appropriate puzzles. Furthermore, Charyn is concerned about Sabrina's speech and language development, as she has fewer words than her peers and struggles with articulating needs. Additionally, Sabrina displays difficulties with behavioral regulation, frequently becoming distressed during transitions, particularly when favorite items are taken away, such as toys or electronic devices.
